### Observed differences

- A27 was executed in every one of the 200 earlier traces; in the later window it appears in about 57 in 100 traces (113/200). [OCC003]
- Five activities that were not observed at all earlier (0/200) appear in the later window: A32, A33, A38, A39 and A40, each in about 44 in 100 traces (87–89/200). [OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008]
- In the later window, A27 and each of these five never occur in the same trace: A27 alone in about 57% of traces, the new activity alone in about 43–44%, so the two options exactly complement each other across all cases. [REL026, REL028, REL029, REL030]
- The branch point sits at A26: earlier, about 99% of A26's observed outgoing transitions led to A27; later about 56% lead to A27 and about 6–10% each lead to the five new activities. [DIR004]
- The new activities run late in the case (mean event position about 0.52–0.53, just after A26 at about 0.46), after the always-present A15/A16 (co-occurrence about 44%, A15 first in about 24%, interleaved in about 20%), and they precede A28 in about 43% of traces; among themselves both orders occur in similar shares (roughly 20–25% each way), so the group has no fixed internal order. [DIR004, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007, POS008, POS009, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011, REL012, REL031, REL032, REL033, REL034, REL035, REL036, REL037, REL043, REL044, REL045]
- A28 still appears in every trace, but its company changed: earlier it always ran together with A27, with A27 first (about 99.5% of cases); later it co-occurs with A27 in about 57% of traces and runs without A27 in about 43%. [REL025, REL031]
- A06 became rarer and later: participation fell from about 24% to about 10% of traces, its mean position moved from about 0.31 to about 0.49, its transitions spread from about 82% concentrated on A16 to about 32%, and the gap from A06 to A16 grew from always one step to one step in only half of the observed cases; earlier A06 always co-occurred with A27. [OCC001, POS001, DIR002, LAG001, REL001]
- Smaller shifts rest on few observations: A10 rose from about 2.5% to about 11.5% of traces, and A04's outgoing transitions changed completely (earlier mainly to A15/A17/A27/A42, later to a wide set of targets). [OCC002, DIR001]
- A15, A16 and A26 remain in every trace and each shifted only slightly earlier in position (mean decreases of about 0.01–0.03). [POS002, POS003, POS004]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that, in the later window, cases branch after A26 between two mutually exclusive options: the previous step A27, taken in about 57 in 100 cases (down from every case), or a group of five activities — A32, A33, A38, A39 and A40, executed in no fixed order among themselves — taken in about 44 in 100 cases and not observed at all in the earlier window. Both options are followed by A28, which still runs in every case, and the new group runs after A15/A16 and A26. [OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008, DIR004, REL025, REL026, REL028, REL029, REL030, REL031, REL036]

Supporting signs: the screening flagged 72 control-flow items where fewer than 1 (0.83) would be expected without change, so random re-splits cannot account for the volume [screening]; the appearance of the five activities and the drop of A27 are observed directly with large supports (87–113 traces per activity), the rerouting at A26 is observed on about 200 outgoing transitions in each window, and the exclusivity and placement around A28 are shown relationally; occurrence, direction, position and relation indicators all describe the same picture. Limitations: positions are event positions, not clock times; the many relation items cover overlapping traces and are not independent confirmations; and the evidence cannot show whether the five activities were newly added or existed earlier without ever being executed, since zero participation only means they were not observed. An important competing explanation the evidence cannot fully rule out is that the earlier window simply failed to sample the new branch as a rare variant, although a path taken in about 44% of cases would be expected to appear in 200 traces.

Other differences: A06 became less frequent (about 24% to about 10% of traces), later in position, with more spread-out successors and a larger gap to A16 — consistent with A06 belonging to the old A27 branch, but that link is not directly established; A10's rise and the complete change of A04's outgoing transitions rest on only 5–23 observations per window and may be sampling noise; A15, A16 and A26 shifted marginally earlier in position. [OCC001, POS001, DIR002, LAG001, REL001, OCC002, DIR001, POS002, POS003, POS004]

Let me analyse this evidence carefully.

Setup:
- Two windows, 200 traces each.
- Screening: 167 units tested, 72 items qualified, 0.83 expected by chance. That's a huge excess — 72 items vs fewer than 1 expected. So the count is many times larger than chance expectation. This means the evidence as a whole cannot be explained by chance. So we're beyond "insufficient evidence" on the screening comparison.

Wait — but the by_family shows only control_flow family: 167 units tested, 72 items, 0.83 expected. So control flow family: 72 items vs 0.83 expected. That's ~87x the expectation. So a real change is strongly indicated at the screening level.

Now let's understand the behavioural story.

Key activities:
- A27: before participation 1.0 (in all 200 traces), after 0.565 (113 traces). Big decrease.
- A32, A33, A38, A39, A40: before participation 0.0 (not observed at all), after ~0.435–0.445 (87–89 traces). These are new activities appearing in the later window.
- A06: before participation 0.24 (48 traces), after 0.10 (20 traces). Decrease.
- A10: before 0.025 (5 traces), after 0.115 (23 traces). Increase.
- A04: DIR001 shows A04's outgoing transitions changed completely (before: A17, A15, A27, A42; after: many new targets). Support before 5, after 18. Small support though.
- A15, A16, A26: participation 1.0 in both windows (always present).
- A28: appears in REL items as B (A27-A28: before cooccurrence 1.0, after B_only 0.435). So A28 was present in all traces before (cooccurring with A27 always), and after, A28 appears in 43.5% of traces without A27. Actually REL025: A27,A28 before cooccurrence 1.0, A_before_B 0.995; after cooccurrence 0.565, B_only 0.435. So A28 still cooccurs with A27 in 56.5% of traces, and appears alone (without A27) in 43.5%.

Hmm wait, A28's participation: before, A28 cooccurs with A27 in 100% of traces, so A28 participation before = 1.0. After: cooccurrence 0.565 + B_only 0.435 = 1.0. So A28 is in all traces in both windows. A28 didn't get an OCC item — meaning its participation didn't change (1.0 both windows). But its relation to A27 changed: before always together with A27 before it; after, in 43.5% of traces A28 appears without A27.

So the story: A27 was mandatory before (in every trace), now optional (56.5%). A32, A33, A38, A39, A40 are new activities that appear in ~44% of traces in the later window, never before. They form a cluster: they cooccur with each other (REL036–REL045: before "neither" 1.0, after cooccurrence ~0.435, neither ~0.565, and both orders A_before_B and B_before_A in similar proportions ~0.2 each — so executed without fixed order between them, i.e., parallel/mixed).

Also REL026, REL028–REL030: A27 vs A32/A38/A39/A40: before A_only 1.0 (A27 always, B never), after A_only 0.565, B_only 0.435, cooccurrence 0.0. So A27 and the new activities are now alternatives: when A27 runs, the new ones don't, and vice versa. Never together.

REL025: A27-A28: before always together (A27 before A28 in 99.5%), after cooccurrence 0.565, B_only 0.435. So in traces without A27, A28 still runs.

REL008–REL012: A15 vs A32/A33/A38/A39/A40: before A_only 1.0 (A15 always, new ones never), after cooccurrence ~0.435, A_only ~0.565, A_before_B ~0.24, interleaved ~0.195. So the new activities now run after A15 in ~44% of traces.

REL020–REL024: A26 vs new activities: before A_only 1.0, after cooccurrence 0.435, A_before_B ~0.43. A26 is at position ~0.46-0.5 (POS004: mean position ~0.495 before, 0.462 after). The new activities are at position ~0.52-0.53 (POS005–POS009: mean ~0.52-0.53). So the new block sits right after A26.

REL031–REL035: A28 vs A32/A33/A38/A39/A40: before A_only 1.0, after cooccurrence 0.435, B_before_A ~0.43. So A28 before the new activities.

So the emerging picture: In the later window, in about 44% of traces, a new block of activities (A32, A33, A38, A39, A40) is inserted after A28 (and after A15/A16/A26), replacing A27. A27 and the new block are mutually exclusive alternatives. A27 went from mandatory (100%) to optional (56.5%). The new activities appear in both orders among themselves (no fixed order — parallel or unordered block).

DIR005–DIR009: A32, A33, A38, A39, A40 have outgoing transitions only in the after window, leading to each other (A28, A33, A39, A40, A32, A38 etc.) — the new block's internal edges. Support ~87-89 each.

DIR001: A04's outgoing completely changed; support 5/18 — very small, weak.

OCC001: A06 participation 0.24 → 0.10. Support 48/20.
OCC002: A10 participation 0.025 → 0.115. Support 5/23 — small.
